messages:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — Northridge Health is green to sign. Legal pushed MSA/DPA redlines and procurement needs PO + signature routing. Can someone from Legal confirm which redlines are blocking? Also need guidance on SLA ask.

Maria Ortiz: forwarding redlines now. @Linda can you take? Procurement sent PO number PO-987654. They want Net30 and a vendor setup form filled.

Samir Patel: POC done last week; delivered SLO report. Customer asked if Dedicated reserved capacity can be included in SLA. Also pricing question: they asked for a pilot discount — any flexibility?

Linda Rosenberg: skimmed the redlines — biggest asks: 1) 99.9% uptime SLA across hosted+dedicated, 2) broader indemnity language, 3) data residency clause. We can't accept 99.9% for all tiers. Propose we counter with: Hosted 99.9%, Dedicated 99.95%, Private depends on infra. Also pushback on unlimited liability — need cap = fees paid in 12 months. I'll add tracked changes and send.

Alex Chen: ok fine. Can SalesOps handle counter offer doc and route for signature? Also procurement asked for order form PDF to attach to PO.

Nate Kim: I can take doc routing. For signatures we use DocuSign (enterprise account). Steps: 1) Legal finalizes counter 2) SalesOps updates order form with PO number 3) I create envelope and route to customer signers + exec sign. ETA 24h after final.

Maria Ortiz: attaching order form snippet:
```
Order Form: Redwood Inference
Customer: Northridge Health
PO: PO-987654
Term: 12 months
Commit: Dedicated 4x A100 reserved
Price: $78,000/month (pilot discount applied)
```
They expect invoice to reference PO-987654 and vendor code VND-4431.

Samir Patel: one technical blocker — customer wants private deployment included in DPA's data flow diagrams. We provided architecture diagram during POC; can Legal confirm that's sufficient? If not, we may need an addendum.

Linda Rosenberg: architecture diagram is fine but we need explicit language in DPA about subprocessors and audit rights. I'll add a short addendum template and mark as optional for Private deployments.

procurement-bot: Vendor setup form link: https://vendor.redwood.internal/forms/setup VND-4431 assigned on submission.

Alex Chen: thanks. Next steps: Linda to upload redline doc by EOD, Maria to update order form with final pricing, Nate to prepare DocuSign envelope. If anyone sees additional blockers tag me. :thumbsup: 

Linda Rosenberg: uploaded redlines here: https://drive.redwood/legal/northridge-msadpa_redlines_v2.docx — added SLA counter and liability cap. Sending to Alex for sign-off.
